bio: George Thomas Duffin, a clerk born at Easton on 1 Jun 1880, married Sophia Gertrude Meier there on 3 Jun 1903 ([R4-S1]). After her death in 1909 he married, on 15 Jan 1917 in Luzerne County, Agatha Mary Rose, daughter of Sophia's sister Mary (Meier) Rose. He lived in Williams Township, Northampton Co., in 1930–42, died at Easton on 4 Aug 1966, and was buried in Gethsemane Cemetery ([R4-S2]).
